paper: KISS-ICP: In Defense of Point-to-Point ICP (RA-L 2023)
recorded_with: reproduce.py stage 1: official kiss-icp 1.3.0, kitti dataloader, KITTI odometry sequences 00-10 (23,201 frames) fetched from KITTI's 84.8 GB zip by byte range - the authors' eval/kitti.ipynb as a script. stage 2 (downstream localizability) unchanged: work/registration_utility.py over the benchmark's 141-frame KITTI 00 release.
note: Stage 1 now reproduces the paper's own table instead of a proxy: mean relative translational error 0.53 % over KITTI 00-10 against 0.50 % in Table II, p.6. The 141-frame sub-sequence this file used to record (0.409 %, 2 metric samples, not comparable) is kept in README.md as the counter-example. Per-sequence differences against the authors' executed notebook are tracked but not gated: the largest is 0.157 pp (seq 01), which matches the deskewing/default-config changes released in kiss-icp v1.2.0/v1.2.2 after the paper.

paper_reported.source: Table II p.6 (and the authors' executed eval/kitti.ipynb, mean 0.4965)
paper_reported.status: REPRODUCED - 0.53 % measured on the official sequences

metrics.regutil_headline: L2: AA ranking dufomap > beautymap > removert_port > removert_official > uncleaned > erasor_port; registration-failure ranking removert_port < dufomap < removert_official < beautymap < uncleaned < erasor_port

environment.patch_required: pipeline.py:130 float() on a shape-(1,) array - NumPy 2 removed it; see work/local_patches.patch
environment.data: KITTI odometry 00-10 (43 GB of the official 84.8 GB velodyne zip, no registration); MulRan/Boreas/NCD remain registration- or form-gated

reference.what: the authors' own executed notebook, per sequence

stage2.question: task book §6 H1' - does the map-quality ranking agree with the ranking by whether a robot can still register into the cleaned map?
stage2.protocol: every map normalised to 0.2 m, then Open3D point-to-plane ICP of each of the 141 frames from a deliberately wrong initial guess; success = <0.2 m, <2 deg, inlier ratio >= 0.30
stage2.limitation: self-registration (the maps were built from these frames), so absolute rates are optimistic and only the ranking comparison is claimed
stage2.excluded: erasor_official - different coordinate frame (official SuMa/bag frame)
